- Mon Mar 11, 09:00–09:30 CET

Thanks, Sean — appreciate the options. Quick thing I'm seeing when I try to add the times to our calendar: your 09:00 CET slot shows up as 01:00 for us (PDT) — that can't be right for our morning window. Did you mean 09:00 CET = 01:00 PST, or did DST shift things?

If 16:00 CET works for your EU team that would map cleanly to 08:00 PDT for us.

Olivia
